content.short: Global Ledger offers blockchain visualization technology and crypto AML risk-scoring solutions.
content.description: Global Ledger offers a comprehensive crypto AML compliance toolset designed for government agencies, banks, fintech companies, and crypto-focused startups. It provides access to AML risk assessments, continuous surveillance, and investigations across blockchain-based assets, supporting regulatory compliance and risk management. By consolidating transaction monitoring, entity risk profiling, and case workflows, it helps public and private sector teams identify suspicious activity, investigate potential violations, and maintain transparency in digital asset markets.
content.meta: Global Ledger is a crypto AML toolset for AML risk, surveillance, and investigations on blockchain assets. Discover Global Ledger and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Crypto Hacks H1 2026: How the Landscape Is Changing
resources.tldr: Built from 224 publicly disclosed incidents rather than impressions. Covers where the money went afterwards, which is usually the more revealing half of any hack.

resources.title: Crypto Sanctions Screening: A Practical Guide for Compliance Teams
resources.tldr: Screening an address is easy; screening for indirect and ownership exposure is where teams get caught out. Works through all three layers with the ordering that matters.

resources.title: How to Report Crypto Scams as a Business: Country-by-Country Guide
resources.tldr: Knowing you were defrauded is not the hard part; knowing who to tell, with what evidence, in which jurisdiction, is. Covers US, UK and Canadian reporting routes concretely.
